title: Ride the urge
subtitle: Urges rise, crest, and fall — like a wave. Ride it instead of fighting it.

steps.body:
An urge feels like it will last forever and only grow. It won't.

Urges rise, crest, and pass, like a wave. This is about riding it — not fighting it, and not feeding it. (If you're in real danger, the Support tab has people who can help right now.)
Notice the urge, without acting on it. You don't have to push it away or judge it. Just turn toward it, the way you'd watch a wave roll in.
Where do you feel it in your body? Notice its edges — where it's strong, where it fades. Just observe it, with a little curiosity.
Now breathe, and ride it. Waves crest and pass. You don't have to do anything but stay with it as it moves and changes.
Whatever it's doing now — bigger, smaller, the same — you stayed with it without being swept away. Each time you do this, it gets a little easier.

exit.body: You surfed it instead of being pulled under. The urge doesn't get the only vote — you do.
